verdicts.reason: A: the logo is shrunk to an unreadable dot far from the eyebrow. The headline is undersized, so the large bag competes with it for attention. It wraps awkwardly ('steps to a'), and the left column leaves dead space above the bag. Even so, the steps, CTA and legal line are readable and well aligned. B: the headline has strong hierarchy and the CTA stands out, but the legal line is shrunk to illegible micro-text. The bag shrinks to a minor item jammed into the bottom-left corner, and the headline sits heavily over the circle, so the left column feels top-heavy and cramped.
